items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The man's name, Dollar Bill. >> [INTERVIEWEE] No. This song was about whenever you get lucky... I've been all around the world, and the only friend that I have had was a good old Dollar Bill.

ctx.x: No. This song was about whenever you get lucky, and all things come your way. Hold on to every dollar, no matter what the people say. I know just what I'm saying. I've been all around the world, and the only friend that I have had was a good old Dollar Bill. If a friend say, Bill, let's have some wine, tell him no. If a friend say, Bill, let's have a good time, tell him no. Oh. And that's always I can go on that. Now that's a song I never heard, but we sang that in his minstrel shows.
